data.description: An xcl plugin for Docker, created from the xcl-plugin-template GitHub template and maintained as the example remote plugin, published as signed GitHub releases and installed through xcl's GitHub releases registry.

evidence.readme: A GitHub template for writing an [xcl](https://github.com/jumppad-labs/xcl) plugin. It is a complete, working plugin with one resource, `notes "note"`, which writes a note to a file. Unchanged, it builds, passes its unit and end-to-end tests and applies its sample configuration, with nothing else running. The same plugin can be registered inside an application or run as a separate plugin program.
